title: KingFisher Flex Magnetic Particle Processing Plate Prep
author: Opentrons

steps.title: Set number of samples
steps.instruction: Specify the number of samples to be run, choosing a value between 1 and 96.

steps.title: Select pipette mount
steps.instruction: Choose the mount on the robot that holds the P300 Single‑Channel Pipette (GEN2).

steps.title: Transfer Wash Buffer 1
steps.instruction: Using a fresh tip, transfer 500 µL of Wash Buffer 1 (distributed as 175 µL + 175 µL + 150 µL) to each user‑specified well of the KingFisher 96‑Deepwell Plate located in slot 4, then discard the tip.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new tip with the P300 Single‑Channel Pipette (GEN2).
Aspirate 500 µL of Wash Buffer 1 (175 µL, 175 µL, 150 µL).
Dispense the aspirated volume into each designated well of the 96‑Deepwell Plate in slot 4.
Drop the used tip in the trash.

steps.title: Transfer Wash Buffer 2
steps.instruction: Using a fresh tip, transfer 1000 µL of Wash Buffer 2 (200 µL × 5) to each user‑specified well of the KingFisher 96‑Deepwell Plate located in slot 1, then discard the tip.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new tip with the P300 Single‑Channel Pipette (GEN2).
Aspirate 1000 µL of Wash Buffer 2 (200 µL five times).
Dispense the aspirated volume into each designated well of the 96‑Deepwell Plate in slot 1.
Drop the used tip in the trash.

steps.title: Dispense Elution Buffer
steps.instruction: With a fresh tip, repeatedly aspirate 200 µL of Elution Buffer and dispense 50 µL into each user‑specified well of the KingFisher 96‑Deepwell Plate in slot 2; return any remaining Elution Buffer in the tip to the source before discarding the tip.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new tip with the P300 Single‑Channel Pipette (GEN2).
Dispense 50 µL into a designated well of the 96‑Deepwell Plate in slot 2.
If more wells remain, repeat the 200 µL aspiration as needed.
After all wells are filled, return any leftover Elution Buffer in the tip to the source reservoir.
Drop the used tip in the trash.

steps.title: Dispense Proteinase K
steps.instruction: Using a fresh tip, aspirate 140 µL of Proteinase K and dispense 5 µL into each user‑specified well (in groups of 24) of the KingFisher 96‑Well Microplate located in slot 3, then discard the tip.

substeps.instruction: Pick up a new tip with the P300 Single‑Channel Pipette (GEN2).
Dispense 5 µL into each target well of the 96‑Well Microplate in slot 3, processing wells in batches of 24.
Drop the used tip in the trash.
